label: def:direct-limit-algebra
title: Quantum Observable Universe as Direct Limit
html:
Let (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau) be a quantum observable universe with substrate parameter q and recursive brane tower \{A_n\}_{n \geq 0}. The direct limit algebra of the quantum observable universe is the colimit in the category of R-algebras:

  \mathcal{A}_\infty
  = 
  \varinjlim_{n}
  \mathrm{End}_{\mathbf{C}}(A_n),

taken over the tower of endomorphism algebras with transition maps induced by the canonical embeddings A_n \hookrightarrow A_{n+1}.

In the archimedean realisation (\mathbb{C}-quantum observable universe), applying the fibre functor \tau yields \mathcal{A}_\infty \cong \varinjlim\Gamma(J^1 \mathcal{S}_n, \mathrm{SU}_{q_n}(2)).
